Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator

name: Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator
storyline: The hot sun beams down on a beautiful Caribbean town. Everyone around would love too cool off with a tasty icy treat (or two), and that means you are exactly where you needed to be in order to pursue your dream of running an ice cream parlor! In Livin' the Cream, this is exactly what you do - run a business where you make and sell ice cream, grow it from its humble beginnings as a lone soft-serve counter to a bustling ice cream store filled with joyful customers enjoying a wide variety of creamy desserts. Progress, unlock new skills and recipes, shop for ingredients, decorate your shop to your liking. Enjoy a broad range of manual activities related to preparing the ice cream of your dream!
summary: Run your own ice cream shop in a vibrant Caribbean setting. Prepare ice cream, mix flavors, add toppings, serve customers, keep your shop clean, restock ingredients, hire staff, and expand your shop from a small stand into a busy business.
